step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an automated batch processing workflow for regulatory compliance transaction processing. Customers upload transaction files to an S3 bucket, which sends event notifications to an SQS queue. A CloudWatch event periodically invokes a Lambda function every five minutes to poll the SQS queue. When jobs are present, Lambda triggers AWS Step Functions. Step Functions invokes another Lambda function that provisions a customized EC2 instance. The EC2 instance retrieves configuration and initialization data from a second S3 bucket, executes batch processing tasks, reports status back to Step Functions, and writes the processing results into a SQL Server RDS database. All components are directly visually mapped from the whiteboard diagram.
